verdict.rationale: Jitsu ships an official, documented `jitsu-cli` that manages workspace configuration objects (destinations, streams, connections) and runs the Functions dev workflow, with `init`/`deploy` commands. The vendor describes it as a real command-line interface that does everything the UI does, and a probe confirms the official docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage in agent-driven workflows.
